title: fix(i18n): add the preview key group to all 8 remaining locales
body:
[objectui#1659](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/1659) added the `preview.*` key group (draft-preview empty states, draft bar, pending-changes panel) to **en + zh only** — the locale-parity test (`all locales have the same top-level keys`) failed on the other eight and was merged over. This adds translated (not English-stubbed) `preview` blocks to ja/ko/de/fr/es/pt/ru/ar.

i18n suite: 100/100 ✅ (parity test green again)
